strongest_angle: The diplomatic tension between Italy and Spain, triggered by migration issues following the Ceuta incident, is moving toward resolution through high-level talks between Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

key_facts.fact: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez held talks to resolve a diplomatic dispute involving border checks.
The diplomatic showdown between Italy and Spain began in the summer of 2026 following a migration crisis at the Spanish territory of Ceuta.
Interior ministers from Italy and Spain are scheduled to meet next week to finalize an agreement to lift the suspension of Schengen rules.
